description: Presidential Secretariat - Commission of Inquiry-enlarge Once again the Period of time ending 21st July, 2021 to 31st July, 2023
categorisation: This gazette content involves the extension of a Commission of Inquiry's reporting deadline through a legal notification. It references specific sections of the Commission of Inquiry Act (Chapter 393) and uses statutory powers vested in the President. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with the implementation and modification of legal frameworks and statutory instruments, rather than government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
